name: NewLinkTypeDialog
intent: Author a link between two object types: both sides, cardinality, visibility and the foreign key that backs it.
when: Relating two object types in a shared ontology
Any create flow over a two-sided relationship
whenNot: Editing an existing link -> open its detail page
Relating records rather than types -> that is data, not ontology

chooseOver.because: It asks for the foreign key that actually backs the link and shows the target primary key beside it, so the relationship is declared rather than implied.

objectTypes.note: Selectable on either side; the first two seed the initial draft.

fkPropertiesFor.note: Foreign-key candidates on side A, scoped by the host.

targetPrimaryKeyFor.note: Target primary key on side B, shown read-only next to the FK picker.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Drafts carry no id; the host mints one on accept.

states.default: Both sides seeded from the first two object types.
states.keyed: A foreign key chosen on side A, with side B's primary key shown beside it.
states.invalid: Creation is refused until both sides and the key resolve.

minimalExample:
import {NewLinkTypeDialog} from "@corensystem/core-ui/new-link-type-dialog";

<NewLinkTypeDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} objectTypes={options} onCreate={addLinkType} />
evaluationCriteria: The foreign key is asked for, not inferred.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted in group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
notes: Already an exported component with a typed props interface and no fixture coupling — this manifest is the only thing that was missing.
